facts.why: Clarence drives a pink Cadillac Eldorado convertible, a deep pink that BAMF Style says leans a little purple. The IMDb summary calls it a pink Cadillac.
facts.reversed: The film's own dialogue calls it Clarence's purple Cadillac (IMCDB), and BAMF Style says it is a deep pink close to purple, so purple stands and pink was the checker's call.

facts.text: Floyd's couch pick. Don't condescend him, man.
facts.why: Floyd is Dick's stoner roommate and he gives up the deal's location. The 'don't condescend' line did not turn up in the Wikiquote page or any other source opened.
facts.fix: Floyd's couch pick. Ask him nicely.
